content: Akngeyel Abram renh ilantheyel, awey ikwerenh artwiletyek
Abram ra aherrety 99-anem. Akngey ikwer aremirrek angkemel, “Ayeng Akngey Atyetyart ra. Nga aleth anaynta, arraty innga.
Abraham-ay, atyeng nga awelhetyek. Atha ngenh alhelek-angkwarr, atha alhelem arrpemarl, atha ngkwenh-rnem akngerr innga ileyenh.”
Abram ahern-warl inngerr kwenirremel atnertel ilperr-ayntek.
Akngey angkek ikwer-warl, “Atha ngenh alhelem, nga Atyetyart anetyek, ingkerrenh ngkwenh-rnem ngkweng-they akngerrirreyenh, apmer arrpanenh-areny-rnemek.
Rernem ngenh itneweyenh Abram-weny, Abraham-ant-anem. Alakenh-anyem nga Atyetyart aneyenh apmer arrpanenh-areny-rnemek.
Atha ngenh akngerr innga antheyenh, ngkwenh ingkerrenh. Rernem apmer arrpanenh-areny aneyenh Atyetyart ilkwernem-then.
Atha ngenh arntarnt-arem, atha ngenh alhelek-angkwarr. Atha arrenhantherr apmer Canaan-anem antheyenh, arrantherr apmerek-artwey-wenyarl aneyel, atha arrenhantherr apmer Canaan anthem arrekantherr.”
Akngey angkek Abraham-warl, “Nga atyeng-angkwarr anayntetyek ngkwenh-rnem-then.
Arrantherr awey arrekantherrenh artwa mpwaretyek, yanh alhelenty aneyenh, atharl arrenhantherr ilek-angkwarr.
Arlta 8 ikwerel-antey arrantherr awey renh-rnem artwa mpwaretyek, alethang-rnem-then ingkerrenh, rernemarl warl ngkwenhel aneyel-rnem-then.
Apmer ngkwenh-itwek atnyenek-rnem-then ntwa ingkerrenh artwa mpwaretyek, warrkenh ngkwenh-rnem-then ingkerrenh.
Rernem alakenh-anyem mpwarey-angenh, rernem atyeng irrpelthirrenty, atha renh-rnem ilek-kety. Angka atyenhek awelhey-angenh anenty, atha renh-rnem atwem.”
Akngeyel Abraham renh ilek, “Ntwa anew ngkwenh Sarai itnewey-angenh, ntwa renh Sarah-ant-anem itnewem.
Atha renh arntarnt-areyel, atha ngkweng aler anthem ikwer-angkwarr. Akngerr ikwer-they akngerrirreyenh arrpemarl, apmer arrpanenh-areny Atyetyart-rnem-then.”
Abraham ra ilperr ayntek arrpemarl. Ra irrpelthirremel atherrek, “Nthakenhan artwa aherrety 100-kenh ampa atnyenetyek? Sarah-el nthakenh ampa atnyeney-angenh aherrety 90-el?”
Abraham-el Akngey renh ayernek, “Ishmael-el-arleng atyenharl?”

Akngeyel renh ilek, “Arrangkw wenh! Anew ngkwenhel Sarah-el awey atnyenem, ntwa renh itneweyenh Isaac. Atha renh ingkerrenh alhelem. Atha ngenh awek ngarl perayirrenh Ishmael ikwer. Atha renh arntarnt-areyenh, akngerr ikwer-they irreyenh, apmer arrpanenh-areny-rnem.
Ra Atyetyart irreyenh 12 prince ikwer-rnem. Atha renh Atyetyart ilkwa anetyek arrerneyenh, apmer arrpanenhek.
Atha arraty mpwareyenh, atha alhelek-angkwarr Isaac ikwer-angkwarr, renharl Sarah-el atnyeneyenh, irrkaty-angkwarr aherrety ingwerel.”
Ikwer-penh Akngey alpek-anem.
Abraham-el Ishmael, alerikw ikwerenh, warrkenh ikwerenh-rnem-then, apmer ikwerenh-itwek atnyenekarl-rnem-then. Ra renh-rnem artwilek, Akngeyelarl ilek-angkwarr.
Abraham aherrety 99 anenh, artwa ampwanem.
Ishmael aherrety 13 anenh, amerrk-antey, rernemarl renh-rnem ingkerrenh-anem artwilek.
Abraham-atherr Ishmael-atherr arlta anyent ikwerel-antey artwirrek.
Abraham-kenh artwernem arlta ikwerel-antey artwirrek arrpemarl.
